about_the_game:
CLOSED ALPHA STARTING NOW - Sign up on our website or on our Discord server!

PBA Pro Bowling is back, and PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is the best bowling game ever. This isn’t just an update - it’s a totally new game, reimagined and rebuilt from the ground up. Play through an extensive Career Mode with a robust character creator, or take the challenge online to compete with friends and rivals. Experience the best gameplay yet with updated ball and pin physics, improved oil pattern simulation, and realistic oil pattern breakdown. Including new game modes, venues, pros, balls, daily objectives, and more, PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is the definitive bowling game - packed with everything fans and players have been waiting for.

Brand New Physics

PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is the most ambitious bowling game ever. Powered by a brand-new engine, it delivers stunning visuals, razor-sharp physics, and an overhauled gameplay system that captures the true feel of the sport.

All-New, Fully Reimagined Career Mode

Unlike anything you have seen in previous versions of the game, this career mode has been completely rebuilt from the ground up. Start as a rookie in your hometown league and work your way up to the PBA Pro Tour, collecting new balls and apparel as you climb the ranks. Choose your own path - focus on traditional bowling competitions or branch out into exciting alternative game modes like Strike Derbies or Candlepin Bowling as you progress from local events to the national stage, building your legacy along the way.

New Game Modes

Candlepin Bowling, Duckpin Bowling, Strike Derbies, Spare Pickup Challenges, and Oil Pattern Roulette add fresh ways to play for exciting gameplay variety.

New & Exciting Venues

Bowl across 13 stunning locations, from iconic real-world stops like the National Bowling Stadium in Reno, NV to imaginative settings like Underwater Bowling. This edition adds 2 brand-new venues, and all 11 returning favorites have been fully remastered for the most authentic and visually striking experience yet.

Build Your Ball Arsenal

Each ball has been authentically recreated with its own natural hook characteristics and material - no upgrades needed and no in-game purchases. Build the perfect arsenal to match lane conditions and unlock new balls as you progress through Career Mode. Featuring real-life balls from the brands you love, there are a total of 272 balls to collect, including 100 brand-new additions and never-before-seen animated balls that make your collection one of a kind.

Play Against the Pros

Take on 32 of today’s top PBA stars, each brought to life with all-new cutting edge character art. Challenge legends and rising stars alike, including 7 new additions such as Packy Hanrahan, AJ Johnson, and Kyle Sherman, as you prove your skills against the very best in the sport.

Official PBA License & Broadcast Commentary

PBA Pro Bowling 2026 is officially licensed by the Pro Bowlers Association and includes in-game commentary from the TV broadcast team of Rob Stone and Hall of Famer Randy Pedersen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 2500K or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 12600 or AMD Ryzen 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
